content.short: C64 Wallet is a community light wallet that provides a sovereign, customized experience for Cardano users and devs.
content.description:
Cardano Protocol Browser Extension Wallet C64 Wallet is a community light wallet that provides a sovereign, customized experience for Cardano users and devs by supporting transactions P2P, staking, transaction with metadata, native tokens, NFTs and other features.

The wallet allows switching networks and unifying all of them within the same tool, in addition, being able to choose your own trusted endpoints, giving total freedom. Private keys are encrypted and stored in the local storage(user side), securing the funds and other personal information.
